# Jeremiah 45 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 45:3 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | You-said, 'Woe now to-me, for YHWH has-added sorrow to-my-pain! I-am-weary with-my-groaning and-rest I-have-not-found.'" |
| LOGOS | You said, 'Woe is me! For the LORD has added sorrow to my pain. I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.'" |
| PNEUMA | You have been saying, 'I'm so miserable! The LORD has piled sorrow on top of my pain. I'm exhausted from all my groaning, and I can find no rest.'" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 45:5 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-you, do-you-seek great-things for-yourself? Do-not-seek. For behold-Me bringing evil upon all flesh,' declares YHWH, 'but-I-will-give to-you your-life as-plunder in-all places where you go.'" |
| LOGOS | And do you seek great things for yourself? Seek them not, for behold, I am bringing disaster upon all flesh, declares the LORD. But I will give you your life as a prize of war in all places to which you may go." |
| PNEUMA | Are you looking for great things for yourself? Don't do it! I am going to bring terrible disaster on everyone, says the LORD. But wherever you go, I will at least let you escape with your life." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
